name: fullstack-dev
description: End-to-end guidance for building and operating full-stack applications, from architecture and data modeling through APIs, frontend delivery, migration, and launch.

interface.shortDescription: Guide full-stack apps from architecture and data through launch.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate architecture, data, APIs, frontend UI, test-driven implementation, security, performance, observability, documentation, CI/CD, debugging, migration, simplification, review, versioning, and staged launch.
defaultPrompt: Guide this app from architecture and data design through APIs, frontend, and launch.
Design the modules, database schema, services, and UI for this feature.
Review, harden, and prepare this full-stack change for release.
